senses.gloss: (b. h.; v. גּוּשׁ) to touch a substance, to strike against.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Challah 2:2">Ḥall. II, 2</cite>; Y. ib. 58ᶜ top <he>הספינה גוֹשֶׁשֶׁת</he> the ship touches the ground (in harbor).

senses.gloss: to feel, grope. Y. Yoma V, 42ᶜ היה מְגַשֵּׁשׁ וכ׳ entered groping &c.

units: <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 8">Lev. R. s. 8</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Judges 13:25">Jud. XIII, 25</cite>, cmp. <he>פַּעֲמֹן</he>) <he>התחיל רוה״ק לגַשְׁגֵּשׁ וכ׳</he> the holy spirit began to ring in Samson.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 22">Gen. R. s. 22</cite>; s. 77; <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 3:6">Cant. R. to III, 6</cite>.

senses.gloss: to exercise one’s strength, practice. Pesik. S’liḥoth. p. 166ᵃ גבור שהוא מִתְגּוֹשֵׁש וכ׳ a warrior practicing on a stone-cutter’s stone.
